design_goals: Use a real single-container ClickHouse analytics pipeline rather than a puzzle or static answer check.
Keep with-skill and without-skill identical except for environment/skills.
Force the solver to repair action-level data engineering issues around schema drift, loading, and monthly ranking.

input_data.notes: Deterministic subset of the official January 2023 NYC TLC Yellow Taxi Trip Records.
Deterministic subset of the official February 2023 NYC TLC Yellow Taxi Trip Records. Preserves the Airport_fee schema drift.
Official NYC TLC zone lookup reference.

intended_failures: The initial loader silently skips February because it assumes airport_fee instead of Airport_fee.
The initial route ranking computes a single global top 20 instead of top 20 per month.
verifier_focus: Recompute expected metrics independently from the provided Parquet and CSV inputs.
Check summary contract, raw row counts, accepted row counts, and both month coverage.
Check exact top_zone_routes contents and monthly ranking behavior.
Rerun the pipeline to ensure idempotence and to catch static-output shortcuts.
